entries.desc: disjoint write-sets (core/foo.ts vs core/bar.ts) -> no overlap; WHY: independence provable, no false positive

evidence.note: smoke asserts disjoint write-sets (core/foo.ts vs core/bar.ts) yield no overlap.

entries.desc: a peer whose scope contract is null/missing is skipped when building peer write-sets (call-site filters null) -> no throw, no overlap for that peer; WHY: legacy stories lacking a contract must not crash the wave projection

evidence.note: smoke models a null/missing-contract peer by omitting it from the peers list (call-site filters null) -> no throw, no overlap for that peer.

entries.desc: multiple active parallel peers each overlapping -> one degradation per peer, each naming the correct peer + pair; WHY: proves per-peer fan-out, no dedup loss

evidence.note: smoke asserts multiple overlapping active parallel peers yield one degradation entry per peer naming the correct peer+pair (per-peer fan-out).

entries.desc: decompositionAdvisoryIssues(story parallelSafe=yes overlapping an active parallel peer, peers, contracts, cfg) returns issues each {type: decomposition_advisory, severity: advisory, message: <non-empty gate advisory>}; WHY: the gate advisories are surfaced at REVIEW as advisory-severity issues

evidence.note: smoke asserts decompositionAdvisoryIssues over a story+peer+contracts yielding gate advisories returns issues each {type decomposition_advisory, severity advisory, message non-empty}.

entries.desc: the returned issues, appended to a sample issues[] containing one blocker, leave blockerCount (filter severity===blocker) unchanged; WHY: proves advisories never raise blockerCount

evidence.note: smoke appends the produced issues to an issues[] containing one blocker and asserts blockerCount (filter severity===blocker) is unchanged.

entries.desc: a story+peers configuration where evaluateDecompositionGate returns advisories=[] -> decompositionAdvisoryIssues returns []; WHY: no advisory, no issue injected

evidence.note: smoke asserts a config where evaluateDecompositionGate returns advisories=[] yields decompositionAdvisoryIssues -> [].

entries.desc: evaluateDecompositionGate returns a non-null block (e.g. overlap_declared_parallel) AND advisories -> only the advisories become issues; the block field is NOT turned into a blocker issue; WHY: enforcement is Story 5; REVIEW must surface advisories only

evidence.note: smoke asserts when the gate also returns a non-null block, only the advisories become issues; the block field is NOT turned into a blocker issue.

entries.desc: a peer with a missing/unreadable contract (not in the contracts Map) -> decompositionAdvisoryIssues does not throw (evaluateDecompositionGate handles peer-unreadable per §4.8); WHY: must not crash REVIEW on legacy peers

evidence.note: smoke asserts a peer with a missing contract (absent from the contracts Map) does not throw (gate handles peer-unreadable per §4.8).

entries.desc: every issue produced has severity exactly advisory (never blocker) and type decomposition_advisory; WHY: a typo to blocker would silently break the non-blocking contract

evidence.note: smoke asserts every produced issue has severity exactly 'advisory' and type 'decomposition_advisory' (never blocker).
